decision: Make gotchas an OPTIONAL field on Agent+Subagent schemas, enforce 'every artifact has a value' via a parity grep/audit task, NOT a required .min(1) field
alternatives: required .min(1) field that throws at module-load; required-as-final-task after all content lands
reasoning: guidance precedent is optional; required field breaks ARTIFACTS barrel + compile mid-wave if any of 20 sites missing; 'mandatory' satisfied by every artifact HAVING a value enforced via audit
risk: optional field lets a future artifact omit gotchas without compile error — audit must catch it

reasoning: learner returns prose parsed by orchestrator which only reads vault/concept/content/tags; content-carry = zero ripple
